messages:
Ari: Planning to land docs PR #623 (migration notes + SDK snippet) in the 2pm docs slot. Netlify preview failed with an artifact shard write error. Can we still get reviews?
Rina: If it's just a large asset, we can swap in a lightweight image and re-run. I can push that in ~8m.
build-bot: Preview failed for branch docs/migration-623 — Error: EEXIST writing artifact shard 5. Logs: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/2012345640#logs
Sam: Quick content pass: the SDK example needs a matching dependency line. I'll add that inline. Local check I used: `mkdocs serve -a 127.0.0.1:8000` — snippet renders.
Marta: Approve for content after Sam's dep fix. Rina, if you can push the optimized asset we can wait for Netlify; otherwise we can merge with a light-assets fallback.
Rina: Pushed optimized images and triggered a rebuild.
build-bot: New deploy started: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/2012345800 (logs...).
build-bot: Deploy 2012345800 succeeded — https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/2012345800
Ari: Approvals in-thread: Sam approved, Marta approved. Merging at 14:02 unless any blockers. Remember to add `docs-release` in the merge message and tag follow-up for hi-res assets.
Sam: Quick post-merge smoke planned to check for 404s.
Marta: I'll open the follow-up PR for hi-res assets behind CDN rules.
Ari: Merged at 14:03. Closing thread.
